strategy: 修復中・弱股隔日當沖空
baseline_rule: Eligible/room filtered 96 trades; NTD5m daily pool equally reallocated after any additional skip; same-day close unless experimental stop hits.

method.sector_open: Equal-weight group open relative to reference close (close minus official spread); strictly positive opening counts.
method.sector_close: Descriptive only: group daily close pct and closing leaders cannot be used for opening decisions.
method.prior_high_stop: Yesterday high + one valid tick. If open >= stop, skip; otherwise if high >= stop, assume exact stop fill; otherwise same-day close.
method.high5_stop: Previous 5 sessions max high + one tick; identical gap skip convention.
method.high20_stop: Previous 20 sessions max high + one tick; identical gap skip convention.
method.fixed_stop: Open*(1+threshold); assume exact theoretical fill, no tick rounding; otherwise close.

limitations: No costs, taxes, slippage, broker quota, fill feasibility or market impact.
Opening group filters assume knowledge of completed opening prints and fills at same open: optimistic diagnostics, not executable pre-open rules; require auction preview/live timing validation.
Daily OHLC supports fixed pre-entry barrier reachability, not intraday turning-point high, sequence, or fills.
Yesterday/5/20-session high definitions are explicit experiments, not user's confirmed definition of an intraday prior high.
Historical constituents are current groups except 6209/4903 entry dates; earlier membership changes are not fully versioned.
Thresholds tested in-sample; targets selected after seeing MAE. No optimized strategy adopted.
Drawdown is cumulative close/stop daily P&L, not intraday portfolio drawdown.

entry_only_comparison.method: Opening diagnostics only; closing exit unchanged; 5m daily pool reallocated among remaining original signals. Leader is strongest prior-signal-day 20-session return, not hindsight day leader. Flat/lower opening means gap <=0.
entry_only_comparison.limitations: Same-open fills after observing group opening prints are optimistic. No delayed intraday entry simulated. No costs/impact. No rule adopted.
